digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified workflow / Ubuntu CI runner efficiency
propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs occupy 11-14 minutes of scarce org-wide runners and contribute to queue contention despite macOS being the completion critical path.
Bridge cadence test repeatedly parses the same 1,440-minute YAML workflow inside a comprehension instead of loading once, causing 342+ seconds per Verified run without adding test value.
Pandoc corpus tests invoke the real binary 3,421+ times to assert only existence/cardinality, when a single short-circuit probe plus static immutable expected outputs preserve all assertion classes.
Default-tier Jira DC-oriented tests are already excluded from Gerrit Verified by the `not integration` selector and run in a dedicated external harness, so moving them saves zero hot-path time.
Behavioral coverage must be preserved by moving full real-Pandoc corpus replay to a scheduled external-integration workflow while keeping bounded live probes and fast drift assertions in Verified.
